title: コモンズ・バサルトテラゾー
description: チャコール色の石片を散らしたテラゾー。床やカウンターに。 ベースカラー画像のみ。Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrappingを両軸に設定。通常Repeat用の対向辺一致は保証しません。
descriptionEn: Fine charcoal basalt terrazzo for floors and counters. Base color only. Set both axes to Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrapping. Opposite edges are not guaranteed to match under ordinary Repeat.
author: Xenoah

provenance.method: Original AI-generated cafe texture, copied byte-for-byte from its recorded source
provenance.rights: Xenoah original image. On 2026-10-14 the owner authorized its publication in the CC-BY-4.0 Meshcopia library. No third-party photograph or texture is included.
provenance.changes: Original PNG is unchanged. A separate resized WebP thumbnail and metadata were added. Original Mirror / mirrored-repeat sampling is retained.
provenance.generationBrief: Dark charcoal basalt terrazzo flooring, dense tiny irregular warm grey and graphite stone chips within dark grey matrix, no prominent large stones. Refined matte contemporary bar floor. NO grid, no grout, no tile divisions.

usage: Mirror / MirroredRepeatWrappingを両軸に設定。通常Repeat用の対向辺一致は保証しません。
